We need answer Chinese multiple choice. Need analyze carefully. User asks: 以下说法正确的是____
Options:
A. 在const成员函数中不可以使用this指针；
B. 在static成员函数中不可以使用this 指针；
C. 抽象类的成员函数都是纯虚函数；
D. 抽象类的派生类必须实现抽象类中的纯虚函数。

Need choose correct. Let's reason C++.
A: const member function can use this pointer; this is pointer to const object, type const Class* const this. So can use this, just cannot modify non-mutable members. So A false.
B: static member function does not have this pointer, cannot use this (unless some trick? It doesn't have this, and referencing this in static member function is error; can't use). So B true.
C: Abstract class has at least one pure virtual function, not all member functions must be pure virtual. False.
D: Derived class of abstract class must implement pure virtual functions? If derived class wants to be non-abstract/instantiable, yes must override/implement all pure virtual functions. But wording: "抽象类的派生类必须实现抽象类中的纯虚函数。" If the derived class itself is abstract, it need not implement all; it can leave some pure virtual. So as universal statement false. However sometimes in exam context might mean to instantiate derived class? Need check. The only unambiguously correct is B. D can be false because派生类 can also be abstract. If question expects single correct, B.
Need final line "答案：B".
